text:
</sub>  Keep benchmark recall based on seeded defects

For the AC8 seeded-benchmark runs, confirmed external defects do not exist by design, yet these lines import AC15(d)'s real-PR denominator and make recall and variance not applicable whenever there are none. This would make every fixture comparison N/A despite AC8 requiring per-seeded-defect recall, so Use Case 3 and AC8 cannot be implemented together. Define benchmark observations over seeded defects and reserve the confirmed-external-defect zero-denominator handling for AC15 real-PR evidence.
